October 27, 2026 
 
To, 
 
BSE Limited 
(BSE: 542726) 
  National Stock Exchange of India Limited
(NSE: INDIAMART) 
 
Subject:    Audio and Video Recordings of Earnings Conference Call on financial results and 
developments for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 
 
Dear Sir/Ma’am,  
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) 
Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform that the audio and video recording of Earnings Conference 
Call for Analysts and Investors held on October 27, 2026, with respect to the financial results and 
developments of the Company for quarter ended September 30, 2026 is available on the 
Company’s website at https://investor.indiamart.com/FinancialResultsStatements.aspx 
 
Please take above information on record. 
 
Yours faithfully, 
 
For IndiaMART InterMESH Limited 
 
 
 
(Manoj Bhargava) 
Company Secretary 
Membership No: F5164 
 
 
 
 
Manoj 
Bhargava
Digitally signed by 
Manoj Bhargava 
Date: 2026.10.27 
19:06:06 +05'30'
